products.title: Products (JSON list)
products.description: One object per SKU: name, price, cost, commission, logistics, competitor. RU and EN keys both work.

tableText.title: Paste a table (CSV / TSV / JSON)
tableText.description: Paste the price list exactly as exported from WB/Ozon analytics. First row = headers. Comma, semicolon and tab delimiters are auto-detected. RU headers: товар, цена, закуп, комиссия, логистика, конкурент.

tableUrl.title: Public CSV / TSV / JSON URL
tableUrl.description: Direct link to a public price-list export (Google Sheets CSV export, own CDN, etc.). No login-protected pages.

marketplace.title: Marketplace preset
marketplace.description: Base 2026 fee profile. wb: commission 22%, logistics 60 RUB, returns 3%, ads 10%, pack 15 RUB, tax 6%. ozon: 25 / 55 / 5 / 12 / 18 / 6. telegram: direct price list, no commission.

commissionPct.title: Commission override, %
commissionPct.description: Leave empty to use the preset.

stressTest1111.title: Run the 11.11 / Black Friday stress test
stressTest1111.description: Adds the promo block to every SKU: promo price, promo profit/margin/ROI and the maximum discount that still clears the minimum margin.

promoMinMarginPct.title: Minimum promo margin, %
promoMinMarginPct.description: The floor used for maxDiscount. Default 10%.

maxRows.title: Max SKUs per run
maxRows.description: Free tier: 50. The TW1-CLIP Pro key removes the cap up to 5000.

includeOffer.title: Include the offer record
includeOffer.description: Adds one final record with the TW1-CLIP Pro key, price and checkout links.
